decisions.reason: The height-adjustable desk system builds directly on our office and conference know-how, and after several years our in-house R&D and system competence give us strong capacity to keep improving and commercializing it.

The sofa remains close enough to our living and lounge knowledge base to retain, but its weaker visibility and less clear strategic pull make it the most plausible candidate for withdrawal if resources are tightened.
The high standing table fits our flexible workplace direction and can be adapted with capabilities we already possess, so the product is worth keeping with only moderate withdrawal risk.
